stemMd: What is cos(2θ) if cos θ = 1/3?
explanationMd: Use cos(2θ)=2cos²θ−1. Substitution gives 2/9−1=−7/9. The result is determined by cosine alone and does not require choosing a quadrant for θ.

distractorRationale.b: This loses the negative sign after subtracting one.
distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly doubles cosine instead of the angle.
distractorRationale.d: This does not follow the double-angle identity.
distractorRationale.e: This squares cosine but omits the rest of the formula.
